name: orka
description: Read shared Orka context, prepare Claude handoffs, and explicitly share selected local snapshots through the Orka desktop app.

interface.longDescription: Read accepted knowledge and shared teammate sessions, and prepare Claude Code handoffs. In Codex and Claude Code on a Mac with Orka installed, explicitly share or update one local memory, skill, plan, or session snapshot without enabling automatic sharing. Existing project permissions and approval requirements still apply. ENV sharing is excluded.
defaultPrompt: Bring me up to speed on one of my Orka projects.
Find a teammate’s shared sessions and explain their decisions.
Prepare this work for continuation in Claude Code.
